stem.text: The diagrams show two different compounds.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of compound 1: a cyclohexene ring with a CHO group on one ring carbon and a methyl group on the adjacent ring carbon, which is part of the C=C double bond in the ring
Skeletal formula of compound 2: as compound 1, with an additional methyl group on the ring carbon at the top right

items: the total number of structural isomers, including compound 2, that could be formed by adding a second methyl group to the ring of compound 1,
the number of $\pi$ electrons in each compound?
